skill.name: surveillance-monitoring

skill.summary: Guides camera status checks, event review, storage monitoring, and coverage audits for Ubiquiti Protect.
skill.author: DataKnifeAI

content.value_statement: Surveillance systems need routine checks across cameras, events, storage, and connectivity. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through focused Protect monitoring workflows.
actual_capabilities: Lists Protect cameras and summarizes camera status.
Reviews recent surveillance events and alerts.
Checks Protect system health and storage usage.
Tracks camera connectivity and network information.
Supports coverage reviews for critical monitored areas.
Produces surveillance status and audit summaries.
limitations: Requires access to configured Ubiquiti Protect tools.
Does not replace physical inspection of camera placement.
Cannot recover footage that the system did not retain.
Results depend on current Protect system permissions and data.

use_cases.title: Daily Camera Health Review
use_cases.description: Check camera status, connectivity, recording state, and storage before daily operations begin.

use_cases.title: Incident Event Review
use_cases.description: Review recent motion, person, or alert events and summarize the timeline for investigation.

use_cases.title: Coverage Audit Planning
use_cases.description: Compare camera coverage with critical areas and identify gaps for deployment planning.

prompt_templates.title: Check Camera Status
prompt_templates.prompt: Show all Protect cameras and summarize their status, connectivity, and recording state.

prompt_templates.title: Review Recent Events
prompt_templates.prompt: Review recent surveillance events from today and group them by event type, camera, and time.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Storage And Health
prompt_templates.prompt: Check Protect system health, storage usage, and camera connectivity. Highlight issues that need action.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Coverage Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a surveillance coverage report for critical areas. Include offline cameras, event gaps, and deployment recommendations.

output_examples.input: Show all cameras and their status.
output_examples.output: A concise camera inventory with online status, recording state, connectivity notes, and urgent issues listed first.
A timeline grouped by camera and event type, with repeated activity patterns and missing recordings highlighted.

output_examples.input: Verify coverage for entrances and storage areas.
output_examples.output: A coverage summary that identifies monitored areas, possible blind spots, offline cameras, and practical next steps.

best_practices: Confirm you are authorized to access camera and event data.
Run health checks on a regular schedule and document issues.
Review retention settings before relying on older footage.
anti_patterns: Do not use surveillance data for unauthorized monitoring.
Do not ignore offline cameras during incident review.
Do not assume motion alerts prove complete area coverage.

faq.question: What systems does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets Ubiquiti Protect camera, event, system health, storage, and network monitoring workflows.

faq.question: Does it control cameras directly?
faq.answer: The skill describes monitoring and review workflows. Control actions depend on the configured Protect tools.

faq.question: Can it review past events?
faq.answer: Yes, it can guide review of available Protect events, alerts, and recordings within retained data.

faq.question: Can it find offline cameras?
faq.answer: Yes, it can guide checks for camera connectivity, recording status, and system health issues.

faq.question: Is it suitable for privacy-sensitive sites?
faq.answer: Yes, if users have authorization and follow privacy, retention, and access-control policies.

faq.question: Does it work without Protect tool access?
faq.answer: No, it needs configured Ubiquiti Protect tools and permissions to retrieve current system information.
